rule: Canonical identity is username plus live BUSINESS/CREATOR provider readback. Discover both id and user_id with INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO(me); id is the provider connection node identity and user_id is the Instagram Graph publication identity for that selected canonical connection. Observed numeric IDs are evidence, never runtime authority.
publish_binding: Use the live user_id returned by the same verified canonical connection for create, publish and readback.
